# SK9030 — An analyzer threw

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

An analyzer raised an exception; it is disabled for the rest of the run and everything else continues.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Tool |
| Default severity | warning |
| Scope | Compilation |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 0.6 |

## Why

A third-party analyzer that throws on one syntax shape must not be able to turn a CI gate red for unrelated reasons — or, worse, green by aborting the run early.

## When it does not fire

None; it reports an exception that happened.
